data.instance_ids: Existing instance_index names one detection within a frame only;new cross-frame tracks are inferred measured-support associations,not certified object identities.

problem: Original geometry-first closing joins all437 terminal class3 quality points into a2591-point component with7.300x3.514m horizontal 5/95extent;active3m predicate rejects it before class vote.

algorithm.pixel_ownership: Use every cached full segmentation mask,including floor/wall. Reproduce existing highest-confidence valid-depth ownership and stable storage-order tie. No boxes,category-specific exclusion or synthetic pixels.
algorithm.measured_voxels: Exactly original QualityMapperV2 validity,3-pixel canonical sampling,first sample per.15m quality voxel,actual captured TF and original planning Z.
algorithm.association: Greedy one-to-one matching of current instance measured-voxel sets against previous track unions,geometry only. Sort eligible edges by decreasing Jaccard,decreasing shared-count,increasing track-ID,increasing local-owner-ID. Never merge existing tracks;unmatched observations create new tracks.
algorithm.quality_membership: At each existing quality voxel key,count measured owned observations per track. Assign a track only for a strict majority>0.5;ties/no majority stay unassigned0. Every original quality point belongs to exactly one track or0.
algorithm.annotation: Only after geometry membership,attach the latest nonzero cached2/3 label from observations of that voxel assigned to that same track. Unassigned or track-unlabeled support retains geometry and receives unknown0 annotation;do not import sticky labels from a different owner.
algorithm.native_eligibility: Within each partition,call preserved observed_patches with original active thresholds:8 support points,3m horizontal5/95extent,.25m vertical extent;no cropping or threshold relaxation.

comparison_contract.G_S_X_geometry: One frozen perception partition shared byG/S/X;score-mode never enters ownership/association/group construction.
comparison_contract.perception_caveat: YOLOE masks depend on text prompts;G is geometry scoring conditional on the same semantic perception,not an entirely semantics-free perception pipeline.
comparison_contract.class_use: Native category annotations differ only after common grouping;native scoring formula would be unchanged,but no scorer or planner is executed by this prototype.
